predecessors.name: Kalabhra dynasty
predecessors.text: the Kaveri delta, 'including Thanjavur, Tiruchirappalli, Sivaganga, Pudukottai, and Perambalur'

successors.name: Chola Empire
successors.text: Thanjavur and the central Kaveri delta

ledger.x: c. 600: the Mutharaiyars consolidate power in the central Kaveri delta. 'Between c. 600 and 850 CE'; infobox established 600, capital Thanjavur; rulers listed from 650 (Kuvavan Maaran).
c. 850: 'Vijayalaya Chola captured Thanjavur from the Mutharaiyars, ending their independent rule.'
c. 850: end of the dynasty; infobox disestablished 850, succeeded by the Chola dynasty.

certainty.note: Districts named, no frontier; dates are 'c.' and the map's Pandya and Chola rows overlap the land.
